title: Warp case study band
description: A full-width brand-blue band under a dot grid of white dots and faint column guides: on the left a small '# case study' tag, a bold geometric headline, a light mono paragraph and a white button with blue text; on the right a 16:10 chart or screenshot on a pale plate. It fades and rises in as it enters.
notes: the image is a media slot (a pale placeholder plate while empty)
made for a saturated primary; on pale primaries the white text loses contrast
name: warp-case

props.name: tag
props.description: the small label above the headline, shown after a "#"

props.name: media
props.description: the chart or screenshot at the right; a pale plate when empty

props.name: mediaLabel
props.description: what the media shows, for screen readers
